name: Disable Samsung telemetry, ACR, voice and account services
description: 1.3.0 adds five units found running and unmasked on a QN65S90F audit: the diagnostics pair (issue_report_agent, abnormal_user_behavior), media-analytics-service, and the far-field-voice and voiceid services (both also given their vendor opt-out switch), plus pushd.socket and farfieldvoice.path. Masks data-service/pushd/bms/appbinary-manager units, plants vendor opt-out switches, kills the ACR service app, Bixby/voice stack, SSO and CIS processes at every boot, and supervises a 30s watchdog. Disable via the manager or the disabled flag; revival needs a reboot.
author: levkropp
